Canada ramps up strategic aerospace and surveillance procurement. 🛰️

### Aerospace & Defence
National procurement frameworks advance through the Polar Helicopter Project alongside the Request for Information for Commercial Satellite Imagery, closing in March 2027. Contractors must integrate advanced maritime tracking telemetry and secure orbital data pipelines to meet stringent Department of National Defence specifications. Systems integrators can structure targeted bids for multi-platform imaging packages and heavy-lift rotary-wing support contracts.

### Trade Compliance & Legal Proceedings
The Canadian International Trade Tribunal initiated expiry reviews for small power transformers from Chinese Taipei and Korea while enforcing strict page limits under Special Import Measures Act proceedings. Importers must assemble granular cost-of-production data and adhere to mandatory 70-page initial submission caps. Advisory practices should structure comprehensive market participation and evidentiary preparation for industrial manufacturers navigating anti-dumping inquiries.

### Transportation & Logistics
Rail freight adjudication proceedings opened regarding noise and vibration compliance under national transportation rules. Operators must audit corridor telemetry and review line-haul service level agreements to mitigate transit disruptions. Trade consultants can package specialized rail-freight dispute-resolution services and vendor audits for affected shippers.

### Cross-Border Enforcement & Security
Cross-border enforcement actions in Essex County resulted in firearm seizures and conspiracy charges under the Customs Act. Importers face severe facility audits and revocation of import privileges if provenance tracking fails. Advisory firms can structure comprehensive supply chain security audits and internal compliance program designs for industrial operators.

### Enterprise Procurement & Infrastructure
Enterprise procurement systems encounter access barriers on CanadaBuys logistics tender platforms, creating risks of missed bidding deadlines. Supply chain teams must establish redundant digital authentication protocols to ensure uninterrupted portal access. B2B advisory firms can offer federal tender intelligence and portal navigation audits for public procurement opportunities.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/trade-compliance/
